## Summary

Describe the change and its motivation.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated where appropriate.
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes, or failures/limitations are explained.
- [ ] `python manage.py mcp-check` passes when the MCP surface changed.
- [ ] `node --check web/assets/app.js` passes when frontend JavaScript changed.

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No credentials, real personal data, private source files, databases, uploads, or generated reports are included.
- [ ] Authorization, consent, evidence, scoring, and approval behavior was reviewed for unintended changes.
- [ ] Documentation and third-party attribution were updated where needed.

## User-facing changes

Describe any changed behavior or documentation.
